---
name: Checkout flow and abandoned carts
description: The three steps of checkout, and where customers actually drop off
type: project
---

Checkout is three steps: cart review, shipping address, payment. Measured over a
month, 61% of abandonment happens on the shipping step, not on payment, and
almost all of it on mobile.

## The address form
The address form asked for a company name before the street. Moving it to the end
and marking it optional cut mobile abandonment on that step by a third.

## Payment errors
A declined card used to clear the whole form. It now keeps everything except the
card number.
